The LENGTH is ours: the pyramid is ~785 m tall and must first appear as "the forme of a tower of an incredible heygth, with a spyre vnperfectlie appearing" and then grow "by little and little" over a walk. TEN STADIA: at 1 850 m an 865 m spire stands about 25° high and grows to fill the sky, which is the effect the passage describes. It is the largest single guess in this table and the one most worth arguing with

The horse is 10 paces in from the court's MOUTH (1499 l. 1255), the elephant straight forward of him, the colossus 88.8 m long on the fallen west colonnade

Square in plan, so its depth is its width. Bury 1998 Appendix; DIMENSIONS.md §2. 10 paces = 14.8 m of clearance to the cliff on each side
